questions.scenario: A mother is asking her son about the time to watch his favorite show.
questions.question:
Mom: ___________________
Son: It's six o'clock. The cartoon is on!
questions.explanation: 根據回答 It's six o'clock (六點鐘)，可知問句是詢問時間。標準問法為 What time is it?。選項 B 和 C 的疑問詞(Where/Who) 錯誤；選項 D 是問年齡。
questions.commonMisconception: 被其他常見疑問句型混淆，沒將 It's six o'clock 與 What time 對接。

questions.scenario: Two students meet at the bus stop in the morning.
questions.question:
Student A: Is it seven thirty? The bus is late.
Student B: ___________________
Student A: Oh no! We are late for school.
options: Yes, it is. It's seven o'clock.
No, it doesn't. It's eight o'clock.
No, it isn't. It's eight o'clock.
Yes, they are. They are eight o'clock.
questions.explanation: Student A 回應 We are late for school (我們遲到了)，推斷現在的時間已經比 7:30 晚了。問句 Is it...? 否定回答為 No, it isn't.。選項 B 的 7:00 不會遲到；選項 C 錯用 doesn't；選項 D 錯搭複數 They are。
questions.commonMisconception: 對於時間 Is it...? 的問句錯用 doesn't 回答，或是無法理解對話中『遲到』的邏輯推理。

questions.scenario: A family is looking at the clock around dinnertime.
questions.question:
Dad: What time is it?
Mom: ___________________
Dad: Let's have dinner now.
questions.explanation: 詢問時間 What time is it? 必須用單數代名詞 It 搭配 is 來回答。選項 B 錯搭 are；選項 C 錯用 they；選項 D 仍是問句語氣不合邏輯。
questions.commonMisconception: 常將 It is 的陳述句型誤用為 Is it 問句型態，或是錯搭複數 Be 動詞。

questions.scenario: A girl asks her brother for the time because she has a piano class.
questions.question:
Girl: My piano class is at four o'clock. What time is it?
Brother: ___________________
options: It's four thirty. You have time.
It's four o'clock. You have time.
It's three thirty. You are late.
It's three thirty. You have time.
questions.explanation: 鋼琴課四點開始。如果弟弟說 You have time (你還有時間)，代表現在還不到四點，因此三點半 (three thirty) 合理。選項 B 指已經四點半了不合邏輯；選項 C 說三點半卻遲到不合邏輯；選項 D 四點正剛好開始，不會說還有優裕時間。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法統合時間數字與情境邏輯 (遲到或還有時間) 的推演。

questions.scenario: Two kids are playing at the park in the afternoon.
questions.question:
Kid A: It is getting dark. Is it six o'clock?
Kid B: ___________________
Kid A: Okay, it's time to go home.
questions.explanation: 天色變暗，朋友問 Is it 且回答 Let's go home，代表確認時間已經晚了。肯定回答為 Yes, it is.。選項 B 意義矛盾；選項 C, D 錯用助動詞 does/doesn't 代替 is/isn't。
questions.commonMisconception: 對 Is it 提問，錯用 does/doesn't 回答。

questions.scenario: A student looks at the clock during a math test.
questions.question:
Student: What time is it?
Teacher: ___________________
Student: Oh! I only have ten minutes.
options: It is ten o'clock. The test starts at ten ten.
It is ten o'clock. The test ends at ten ten.
It is ten thirty. The test ends at ten ten.
It is ten o'clock. The test ends at ten thirty.
questions.explanation: 學生說只剩十分鐘 (only have ten minutes)。若現在十點整，測驗在十點十分結束 (ends at ten ten)，剛好是十分鐘，符合邏輯推理。選項 B 是三十分鐘；選項 C 已經超時；選項 D 是測驗開始不符語境。
questions.commonMisconception: 對時間進行加減 (10 點 + 10 分鐘) 推算感到困難，無法選出合理的對話設定。

questions.scenario: Dad is waking up his daughter for a school trip.
questions.question:
Dad: Get up! It's five thirty.
Daughter: ___________________
Dad: Yes, the bus leaves early.
options: Is it five thirty? It's so early!
What time is it? It's so early!
Are you five thirty? It's so early!
Is it five thirty? It's so late!
questions.explanation: 因為爸爸已經說 It's five thirty，女兒訝異地反問 Is it five thirty? (五點半了嗎？好早！)。從後面老爸說『對，車子很早開』確認。選項 B 重複問時間；選項 C 錯用 are you；選項 D (so late) 語意矛盾。
questions.commonMisconception: 把 Is it (反問確認) 與 What time (直接提問) 的使用時機混淆。

questions.scenario: A grandmother asks her grandson to look at the wall clock.
questions.question:
Grandma: I can't see the clock. ___________________
Grandson: It is nine o'clock, Grandma.
questions.explanation: 標準詢問現在幾點的句型是 What time is it?。選項 B 詞序錯誤；選項 C 和 D 是錯誤的疑問詞翻譯 (何時是時間/時間在哪裡)。
questions.commonMisconception: 中式英文直翻，認為時間可以用 When is the time 來問現在幾點。

questions.scenario: A child is impatient while waiting for a movie to start at two o'clock.
questions.question:
Child: ___________________
Mom: No, it isn't. It's only one thirty.
questions.explanation: 根據媽媽的回答 No, it isn't. 可以得知這是一個 Yes/No 問句，且從「才一點半」可推論小孩原本在問期待的兩點到了沒。選項 B 無法用 Yes/No 回答；選項 C 則媽媽會回答 Yes；選項 D 錯用複數。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法從回答的 No, it isn't. 推論出問句必須是 Is it 開頭的封閉式問句。

questions.scenario: At the train station, a man asks a staff member checking the schedule.
questions.question:
Man: Excuse me. Is it eleven o'clock?
Staff: ___________________ The train is here.
questions.explanation: 從 The train is here 可判斷，符合了班車到達的時間，所以是肯定回應。對於 Is it 提問，簡答為 Yes, it is.。選項 C 與 D 錯搭助動詞 does。
questions.commonMisconception: 在簡短的對話中，忽略助動詞對稱的鐵律，而將 is 與 does 混用。
